record_body:
ACCOUNT SUMMARY
- Enterprise payments processor. Current LLM use is internal-facing (agent assist + knowledge base) but wants ability to expand to customer-facing later.
- Strong preference for Dedicated or Private (VPC) due to regulatory posture + internal risk appetite. Hosted API considered for pilot only if retention/residency acceptable.

PRIMARY CONTACTS (THEIR SIDE)
- Security/GRC lead (runs vendor assessments)
- Platform Eng lead (owns AI gateway + logging)
- Legal / eDiscovery contact (owns legal hold requirements)

WHAT THEY CARE ABOUT (top themes from calls)
- “Retention needs to be configurable and provable.” Not sufficient to say logs expire; they want to see what data types exist and how deletion is enforced.
- Audit log exports: want exportable, tamper-evident-ish logs for internal SIEM ingestion. Asked about format, fields, and whether exports can exceed retention window.
- Legal hold: must be able to preserve specific audit logs / admin activity beyond standard retention for investigations and litigation holds.
- Evidence pack: requested a short, customer-facing packet they can attach to the security review (SOC2/ISO-aligned language ok; they don’t need full SOC report right now).

RETENTION REQUIREMENTS (as stated; may change after their internal review)
- Audit logs: 365 days minimum retention (preferred). Asked if 7 years is possible for certain subsets; we said “not in v1 as customer-configurable; can discuss contractually / via export + customer storage.”
- Admin activity logs (Console / config changes): 365 days.
- Inference request metadata (not raw prompts): 30–90 days depending on environment (prod shorter; staging ok longer). They asked for clarity on what we store as “metadata.”
- Telemetry/analytics: 90 days default acceptable; ok with aggregation beyond that if no identifiers.
- Operational logs: they understand some infra logs may have fixed vendor/SRE retention; they want a list of what’s in scope vs out of scope.

DATA RESIDENCY / DEPLOYMENT
- Phase 1 must be US-only (compute + storage). Asked if Dedicated in a specific region is supported and whether failover would cross regions.
- Private (VPC) is likely required for production if we cannot guarantee residency controls + isolation to their satisfaction.

OPEN QUESTIONS (WE OWE)
- Provide a clear list of data types covered by retention controls in v1: audit logs, admin activity, request metadata, telemetry tables (eligible subset), etc.
- Clarify whether “audit logs” include both Console/admin events AND key platform events (API key changes, role changes, retention policy changes, export creation).
- Provide details on retention enforcement: TTL vs scheduled deletion jobs, how we verify deletion/compaction, and how customers can see “last run / status.”
- Exports vs retention: confirm that exports cannot retrieve events older than retention window, and what warnings/metadata appear in exports.

EVIDENCE / ARTIFACTS REQUESTED
- A short compliance reporting pack (PDF ok) that includes:
  - Retention policy statement + defaults and configurable ranges (min/max)
  - Audit log coverage summary (what events, where visible, export options)
  - Explanation of legal hold semantics (who can set, approval, how enforcement respects holds)
  - Control-to-evidence matrix (SOC 2 / ISO-style mapping) — “lightweight is fine”
  - How to request evidence refresh / cadence (quarterly ok)

RECENT ACTIVITY TIMELINE
- 2025-01-22 — Inbound via partner intro; initial discovery booked.
- 2025-01-30 — Discovery call: use cases + deployment preference (VPC). Flagged retention + audit logs as gating items.
- 2025-02-06 — Security review deep dive (Fireflies: ff-2025-02-06-security-review-prospect-a). Key ask: 30/90/365 retention options + legal hold.
- 2025-02-07 — Internal coordination started via CISO mailbox thread (Gmail: thread-2025-02-07-retention-controls-security-review). Aisha + Olga looped for evidence pack.
- 2025-02-10 — Support ticket SUP-4870 opened to track “compliance report” request (internal coordination for shareable packet).
- 2025-02-13 — Procurement/legal call (Fireflies: ff-2025-02-13-procurement-legal-retention-terms). Legal asked for retention language + audit export commitments; flagged legal hold requirement.

INTERNAL NOTES (REDWOOD)
- Fatima to lead the next security call; Markus to drive commercial timeline + procurement mapping.
- Need to align messaging: v1 retention controls cover specific datasets; avoid promising “all logs everywhere.” Be explicit about out-of-scope infra logs.
- Recommend positioning: Dedicated + retention controls + audit exports; Private as option if they need stronger residency + customer-managed networking.
- If they insist on >365 days retention inside Redwood, steer to export/SIEM + customer storage pattern.

RISKS
- If we can’t provide a crisp evidence pack quickly, they may default to Bedrock/Azure due to existing vendor relationship.
- Legal hold semantics are a hard gate. They want workflow + periodic review described (even if initially manual/exception-based).

REFERENCES
- Fireflies transcripts: ff-2025-02-06-security-review-prospect-a; ff-2025-02-13-procurement-legal-retention-terms
- Gmail thread: thread-2025-02-07-retention-controls-security-review
- Support/Jira: SUP-4831 (security review asks), SUP-4870 (compliance report request), INT-912 (standard export pack)
